schedule: Original actual router and current demand map run first.
Fixed EARLY Top8 CPU hint uses current after-mixer residual and next-layer postNorm/router buffers.
Only nonresident hints enter a serial pair queue after current map success. Each pair joins its two original streams before starting the next pair.
Current MoE and next mixer may overlap reads. No kernel or GPU scheduler changes.
Next actual demand drains the whole batch before cache locks. Its original LFU plan alone chooses actual misses and destinations.
Invalidate actual victims, validate both ranges before import copy, join every original logical worker, then retain original serial publication hook/cancellation/validateBoth/slotExpert ordering.
checks: Positive private hooks.none provenance; supplied callbacks are never eligible.
Typed owner binds the actual cache, retained source, admitted ranges, layer, geometry and original cache quota.
Every speculative slice uses unchanged preadTensorRange with fresh original checks. Hints cannot provide ranges or numeric source offsets.
Only settled owner/layer/expert/position/epoch-matching actual misses import. Copies cannot change after original publication validation.
Original hit, full-source, demand read, publication, lease and pre-GPU checks remain.
All worker outcomes drain. Pure expected cancellation remains cancellation. Mixed source/read failures retain original pair/stream order.
Production failures remain primary in a compound failure if speculative work also failed. Token rollback follows speculative drain.
lifecycleResolution: Read group sentinel enters before the batch is published, so pending launch cannot look idle.
Pool keeps its draining batch visible until settlement completes. A second drain is rejected.
Cancellation joins read work, the drain owner and any returned import lease outside all locks.
Epoch becomes reusable only after every import job has settled. New start cannot overwrite live quarantine bytes.

timingIntervals.copy: Actual bounded CPU copies into original reserved slot buffers; worker sums may overlap.
timingIntervals.beforeCopyValidation: Fresh validateBoth before imported pair copies.
timingIntervals.publicationValidation: Original validateBoth after all workers settle. Serves the after-copy observation. No extra duplicate check.
timingIntervals.fullSource: Every existing direct runner revalidateSource call during decode. No new full source scan is added for hint computation.
timingIntervals.limits: No new full GPU trace. Requested bytes are logical, not measured physical disk bytes. Nested intervals must not be summed as independent savings.
